html: The Yinggarda, also written Yingkarta or Inggarda, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gascoyne region of Western Australia, around the lower Gascoyne River and present-day Carnarvon. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Their neighbours were the Malgana of Shark Bay to the south, the Baiyungu to the north and the Tharrkari and Warriyangga inland. Sheep stations took up the Gascoyne from the 1870s, and Carnarvon was founded in 1883 as their port. Their language is endangered, and work is under way to revive it.
